profile.name: R. Barela
profile.intro: R. Barela is a Hispanic artist and filmmaker based in Albuquerque, New Mexico, working in the traditional Spanish colonial arts.

bio.alt: R. Barela wearing a black leather jacket over a red and white shirt.

bio.body:
*They/them · Albuquerque, New Mexico*

They trained under santero Charles "Charlie" Carrillo in retablos and bultos, and exhibited at Santa Fe's Traditional Spanish Market from 2012 to 2015. Their practice uses traditional methods and cultural heritage to support surreal visions, in painting, object-making, and film, where they work as a writer, director, producer, and art department artist.

A member of the independent film collective [Dust Wave](https://dustwave.xyz), Barela has worked in the Albuquerque indie film scene since 2022 and exhibited in the [Taos Film Festival](https://taosfilmfestival2026.eventive.org/schedule/69c42420affd083f00d0de73) exhibition “*[Life After Dead Air](https://dustwave.xyz/project/life-after-dead-air.html)*” in 2026.

## Training

- Traditional Spanish colonial arts (retablos and bultos), under Charles "Charlie" Carrillo, Santa Fe, NM

## Exhibitions

- *“deep inside”, [Life After Dead Air](https://dustwave.xyz/project/life-after-dead-air.html)*, [Taos Film Festival](https://taosfilmfestival2026.eventive.org/schedule/69c42420affd083f00d0de73) exhibition, Taos, NM, 2026
- *Zozofest*, Santa Fe, NM 2012, 2023
- *Nuevo Mexicano Heritage Arts Museum*, Santa Fe, NM 2014
- *Traditional Spanish Market*, Santa Fe, NM, 2012-2015

## Affiliations

- Member, [Dust Wave](https://dustwave.xyz), independent film collective, Albuquerque, NM

## Awards, Grants & Press

entries.title: deep inside
entries.intro: A carved angel with a moving-image interior.

cover.alt: A carved pine angel with an open chest revealing ribs, a heart, and a small illuminated screen.

blocks.body:
*deep inside* presents itself first as something familiar, an angel carved from pine in a traditional Spanish colonial style. However, the chest is opened, revealing a more raw interior: a ribcage and a suspended heart. Within the heart, a small screen displays two rabbits, at times affectionate and at times in conflict, moving through a quiet, dreamlike loop. The work explores the tension between what is outwardly presented and what is held within.

## Materials

Pine wood, LCD display, polymer clay, acrylic paint, digital media player, latex

Part of the exhibition [Life After Dead Air](https://dustwave.xyz/project/life-after-dead-air.html).

entries.title: Initials on the Chamber Walls
entries.intro: you always loved possessing what was yours

blocks.body:
trapt in the confides of my heart

you spent your time well

carving your name into the chamber walls

so that anyone who managed to enter

may see that you were there

at least, at one time

like breathing in your air for the first time

familiar, nostalgic

our rib placed back into my tender chest

created from the same stars and returned again

dreaming that it has meaning

rolling down from the top of the hill

into pink ribbons and haze

heavy eyes resting in the comfort of forget-me-nots

and the warmth of the sun to hold me close

entries.title: The Intimacy of Touching Knees in a Theatre
entries.intro: Delusions of connection in the most obvious of places

blocks.body:
Dimmed lights and retro, comfortless seating. A provocative film broadcasting the deepest desires you never knew were within you. Your friend leans over to make jest and you canʼt help but admire how the glare of the projection illuminates his face. As you return your shy gaze to your knees, peeking out of the hem of your skirt, you feel his knee gently pressed against your own.

*God, why canʼt his entire body be pressed against mine?*

Maybe itʼs the dusky cinema, maybe itʼs sitting closely with another person and being a bit touch-starved. Or perhaps even finally sharing a moment, appreciating tantalizing craft, *together.* Whatever it is, itʼs captivated your psyche in this moment.

As the movie plays out upon the screen, thereʼs no need to bring out the fantasies of your personal archive, the dreamy love affair is unfolding in front of your eyes. You become the players, exchanging a forbidden confession of harbored desires, finally embracing after all this time. The slow burn has finally caught enough wind to set your body ablaze.

The warmth of his outer thigh melts your inhibitions, as it leans alongside your own. Each turn of his visage toward you sends you into a momentary daydream of looking into those deep espresso eyes and feeling the gentle push of his lips against your own, or the glide of his hand across your thigh to intertwine his fingers between yours.

*Just anything to replace the sensation of how much this tiny seat is hurting your massive ass.*

Blood boils in the heat of your cheeks, the players consummate their affection tenderly. Your heart beats ever so quick as you occasionally peer out of the corner of your eyes.

*Does he feel some sort of way about watching two lovers become intimate? Is he imaging me in that situation? Should I not imagine him, even if I want to? Does he have a weird dick? Thank GOD this theatres dark, he would know exactly what Iʼm thinking of if he could see the rose flush across my face.*

It feels like you canʼt breathe until you manage to release one shuttery sigh to reset your thoughts. The glance from his downturned eyes and his slightly-parted lips informs you of his cognate thoughts. The denouement begins to cool you off and as the resolution sets in, he shifts his body and your knees no longer touch.

As the lights come back up, he offers you a polite and sheepish smile. You both pretend to care about the otherʼs interpretation of the film before saying an awkward goodbye and sharing a much too gentle hug. Something about the glow of the sconces transformed you from lovers back into casual friends. Your only lingering thought of the interaction is-

*I could go for a cigarette right about now.*
